name: Tattu R-Line V3.0 4S 1550mAh 120C
notes: Retailer spec list (the old gensace.de URL is dead): 4S1P 14.8 V, 1550 mAh, 120C, "Net weight (± 10 g): 176 g", "76 mm x 38 mm x 33 mm (L x W x H)", XT60. Burst "240C" from RaceDayQuads' listing (archived: http://web.archive.org/web/20250327104020/https://www.racedayquads.com/products/tattu-r-line-version-3-0-1550mah-14-8v-120c-4s1p-lipo-battery-pack-with-xt60-plug, which gives 181 g and 77 x 38.5 x 32.5 mm). energy_Wh = 14.8 V x 1.55 Ah and maxDischargeCurrent_A = 120 C x 1.55 Ah are DERIVED. Internal resistance: not published (the old 8 mΩ had no source).

name: Molicel P42A 6S1P (cells only)
notes: Modelled as SIX BARE CELLS, not a product pack. Molicel's cell page: "3.6 V" nominal, "4.2 Ah", "45 A" maximum continuous discharge, "70 g" (maximum cell weight), 21.7 mm x 70.2 mm (maximum), 230 Wh/kg. DERIVED for six cells in series: 21.6 V, 90.72 Wh, 45 A, continuousC = 45 A / 4.2 Ah = 10.7, weight 6 x 70 g = 420 g (an upper bound for the cells; wrap, wiring, balance lead and connector are not counted). Pack dimensions, connector, burst rating and internal resistance: TODO(source). A real 6S1P P42A pack does exist (BTRY, https://btry.energy/en/p/akb-dlya-fpv-btry-6s1p-molicel-inr21700-p42a: "Weight, kg 0,38", 63.9 x 42.6 x 72 mm, 45 A, XT-60), but its 380 g is below the cells' own published maximum, so it is not used. The earlier record's 435 g, 142 x 44 x 44 mm, 15C burst and 32 mΩ had no source and its URL was dead.

name: iFlight Fullsend 6S2P 8000mAh Li-ion
notes: Manufacturer page: "Capacity: 8000mAh", "Battery Capacity: 177.6Wh", "Voltage: 22.2V", 6S2P, 42 x 64 x 147 mm, "Weight: 840g±10g", "Discharge rate: 17.5C", XT60H. The page lists 22.2 V nominal; the physics uses the Li-ion 3.6 V/cell rule (21.6 V) for pack voltage and the published 177.6 Wh for energy. maxDischargeCurrent_A = 17.5 C x 8 Ah, derived; maxVoltage_V is 6 x 4.2 V, the standard Li-ion full charge, not stated on this page. Cell model per the page changelog: EVE INR21700-40PL. iFlight's Chimera7 O4 page implies a heavier pack (1621 g takeoff - 725 g = 896 g).

name: Tattu Plus 6S 16000mAh 15C Smart
notes: Manufacturer page (SKU with AS150+XT150): 6S1P, 22.2 V, minimum capacity 16000 mAh, 15C continuous, 30C burst, "Net Weight(±20g): 2063", 230 x 81 x 70 mm. Energy is not published as a number (only "Over 300wh: Yes"); 355.2 Wh = 16 Ah x 22.2 V, derived. maxDischargeCurrent_A = 15 C x 16 Ah, derived; maxVoltage_V = 6 x 4.2 V.
